title: Keep physical consistency and acquisition conditioning explicit
statement: Exact inverse rays require a positive finite-control factor and finite-data endpoint and rate margins.

evidence.quote: # Recovering a Markov generator from stationary barrier-intervention snapshots
# Correction: direct endpoint recovery by a classical maximum principle
# Independent audit of the direct endpoint correction
# Independent audit addendum: direct endpoint recovery supersedes graphic reconstruction

requires: Fully observed finite named Markov states, column generator W, irreducible unique pi>0, separately accessible stationary laws before/after actual single-pair local interventions. Symmetric barriers multiply BOTH opposed positive rates by unknown t>0,t!=1. Nonzero response requires nonzero baseline pair current. Known-target theorem assumes supplied simple connected bidirected support and active selected edges spanning one cycle-matroid component. Corrected UNKNOWN-target theorem assumes n>=3, distinct active pairs forming a spanning BIDIRECTED BICONNECTED graph. Extra unperturbed rates, including directed one-way rates, allowed in corrected blind case. Hidden states, parallel channels and locality verification are not supplied.
provides: D!=0 and t=1-alpha/D>0,t!=1 is necessary AND sufficient for the proposed finite symmetric local intervention once V is reconstructed. Promise of locality is not validated merely by matching response rays.
Endpoint assignment stable under g>2B; known-target directional error bound 2sqrt(2)||E||/sigma with ||E||<=eta sqrt(n^2+4mn(n-2)) is separate. Baseline samples are shared, not repeatedly free.
Small probabilities, weak currents/interventions, nearly tied extrema, slow mixing and singular-gap deterioration can dominate acquisition. No noise-independent sensing improvement.
assumptions: Recover generator only up to ONE POSITIVE GLOBAL CLOCK; no absolute rates or entropy production per physical time. Equilibrium symmetric barriers are blind, and bridges/articulation blocks can leave distinct scales. Sufficient cycle/biconnectivity assumptions are NOT a full necessity characterization of constrained physical inverse problems. No uniform finite-data guarantee or experimental capability/advantage. The earlier audited blind theorem with 3-vertex-connected selected graph remains valid HISTORY, but graphic-matroid recognition, Whitney reconstruction and row-permutation alignment are UNNECESSARY. CORRECTION.md and its independent audits govern: a CLASSICAL relative-response maximum principle identifies endpoints directly. Hunter2002 Corollary4.1.2/page93 is a direct DTMC relative-response predecessor, not claimed to contain the whole CTMC full-generator theorem. No priority clearance or newly discovered maximum principle.
costs: Known labels: solve 1^T K=0,K pi=0,K d_e parallel b_e; cycle-ray rigidity gives K=cW, normalize -tr K=1 and generator sign. Unknown labels: scan extrema of h_i=d_i/pi_i=pi_prime_i/pi_i-1 then the SAME labelled linear system. Exact rational divisions/comparisons/Gaussian elimination have polynomial bit cost. Finite symmetric-control compatibility still requires D=(V_ba e_a-V_ab e_b)^T pi_prime !=0 and t=1-alpha/D>0,t!=1 for Vd=alpha(e_b-e_a); invariant under V scaling. For IID stationary samples N/condition, eta=sqrt(log(2n(m+1)/delta)/(2N)); mixing, settling, effective independent sample count and physical controls are paid. Corrected endpoint ratio error B=2eta/r+2eta/r^2 if eta<r/2,r=min pi, and endpoint gap g>2B plus arithmetic error suffices. Sharper eta(1+R)/(pi_min-eta) uses R=max pi_prime/pi. Rate reconstruction additionally pays its nonzero constraint singular gap, small-rate positivity and division sensitivity; old matroid rank-oracle margins are not needed for corrected acquisition.
contract.units: Source-local rates,energies,TV/half-diamond and counting conventions; no automatic conversion.
